extracted.name: Spruced up McCormick Texas Chili packet
extracted.description: Just wanted to add a bit more to the basic recipe on the back of the packet
ingredient_lines: 1 Packet McCormick Texas Chili seasoning mix
1 pound ground beef (could use other types of meat as well)
1 jalapeno chopped & seeded (your preference on how much to use or if at all)
1/2-1 can mild Rotel (diced tomatoes and green chilies), undrained
1 russet potato chopped (your preference on how many potatoes you like)
instruction_lines: Add chopped onions, jalapeno's and chopped potatoes to meat, stir to combine
Add 1 packet McCormick seasoning packet. Mix with meat mixture until combined.
Add fire roasted tomatoes and Rotel mixture, stir until combined.
Cover, reduce to low heat and cook. Stir occasionally. Cook for about 30 min on low heat.
Serve with cheese, sour cream, corn bread and/or sides of your choice. (I let me chili sit overnight and eat the next day after all flavors have had a chance to combine together.)
